thread:
sasha: starting v2 canary to gateway (eu region) now, ~5% traffic. tagging this thread for any client-impact issues.
deploy-bot: rollout job 7592 started, canary groups: eu-small, eu-standby. monitoring enabled.
tim: seeing a spike of 400s from mobile-sdks within the canary group. quick grep shows header mismatch errors in the gateway:
```
ERROR: missing required header X-Client-Id (received x-client-id)
```
priya: thanks tim — that screams header canonicalization change. @kyle did we tweak header normalization in the gateway PR for v2?
kyle: checking PR 459 — yes, I removed the lowercase shim to match upstream envoy behavior (expected proper-case headers). that explains it.
emily: mobile clients still send `x-client-id` lowercase. quick fix options: reintroduce shim at gateway, patch v2 to accept lower-case, or pin mobile route to preserve v1 behavior.
sasha: pause canary immediately while we decide. we can't risk a broader regression. @deploy-bot pause job 7592.
deploy-bot: rollout job 7592 paused by sasha at 10:09PT. draining new connections, keeping canary hosts alive.
tim: I can add a routing-layer normalizer to accept both cases, but that's an extra hop (+~2ms). alternative: quick v2 patch to lower-case header handling (tiny change).
kyle: reintroducing the shim is fastest on infra side — small config and rollout, ~15m including smoke. I can do that.
priya: decision proposal: 1) add client pin for mobile route to force them to v1 behavior while we revert shim 2) revert PR 459 (reapply shim) and smoke 3) resume canary after validation 4) schedule a proper v2 backward-compatible change for next patch. opinions?
emily: +1 to pin & revert. I'll notify mobile-sdks to hold any app-side deployments.
sasha: agreed. sasha to update release notes and incident stub (INC-9876). pausing public release notes until we confirm. ETA for revert + smoke: 30-40m.
priya: I'll update our rollout doc and set the canary window +1h to avoid auto-scheduling.
kyle: prepping patch now. command I'll run once approved: `kubectl apply -f gateway/header-shim-v2-revert.yaml` then smoke tests: `./tools/smoke mobile-canary`. ping when smoke green.
sasha: deploy-bot — note that while paused, auto-rollback thresholds are suppressed. make sure not to auto-forward.
deploy-bot: ack — auto-rollback suppressed for job 7592 while paused by user sasha.
tim: logging: saved traces to s3://redwood/logs/canary/7592/headers/ for postmortem.
emily: I'll message #mobile-sdks and ask product to delay any client releases for the next hour.
priya: thanks everyone. final action list in thread: [ops] add client pin to mobile route, [kyle] revert shim and smoke, [qa] run mobile smoketests, [sasha] update INC-9876 and release notes. resume canary after green.
sasha: good work. keep updates here — escalate to eng-oncall if we hit failures during revert. :thumbsup:
